Name: Rumah
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include Horbat Rumah, Khirbet Urmah, and Dura
Description: Rumah was the home of Pedaiah, whose daughter Zebudah was the mother of King Jehoiakim of Judah.
BiblicalSignificance: Rumah appears only as a family home in the royal genealogy, a reminder that the kings of Judah came from named towns and families.
